question: Does the previously unresolved matter-stress atomic response remain unresolved when initial physical Pi_m is substantially larger in a physically admissible matched family?
scope: New matched semi-relativistic nonbaryonic collisionless component. Not a pure continuation of the original cold-component experiment. No observational cosmology admission.

old_family_bound.bound_scope: Exact angular-family positivity bound at Sigma0=0 for the admitted discrete quadrature, not a universal bound on arbitrary matter distributions.

family.angular_distribution: Same frozen positive canonical FV f(q,mu) proportional to [exp(q)+1]^-1*(1+A_m P2(mu)); reflection even, zero bulk velocity.
family.momentum_scale: Tref denotes the nonbaryonic momentum scale, not the prescribed gas temperature.
dynamically_different: massive energy and isotropic pressure after initial time
family.cross_family_change: m/Tref and massive fraction differ from the cold family; initial massive pressure and composition are therefore different across families. Compare each strong case to its new matched zero anchor.

discrete_matching.rho0: CanonicalMomentumFV reference_energy_norm is the same quadrature sum of packet energies: rho(0,0)=1 to binary64 reduction error for every A.
discrete_matching.pressure_identity: At eta=b=0, pbar is independent of A and pi_s=A*pbar/5. Positive Gauss angular quadrature integrates the needed polynomials exactly to rounding; verify actual discrete values.
discrete_matching.mapping: P_m0 = [KAPPA_T*sqrt(6)*rho_crit*(Omega_m*f_m/a_ref^3)/H_init^2]*pi_s. Determine coefficient with actual chosen quadrature, then A=target/coefficient; verify actual diagnostics. Do not call old amplitudes_to_axes, which hardcodes fm=.1 and mass30.
discrete_matching.fine_mapping: Recompute coefficient for the control quadrature so realized target Pi=.1 matches; report tiny changed A and initial pbar quadrature discrepancy.
discrete_matching.number_note: Reflection symmetry gives zero mean velocity even though the velocity dispersion is large.

numerics.nuclear_postprocess: Only the four new nominal histories; existing admitted rates and instant-thermalization passive closure. Control may omit nuclear postprocessing because target is atomic/geometry convergence.
numerics.budget_policy: Count actual CPU for all new runs and any failed attempts; no automatic extra IVP or parameter search if a gate fails.

adapter.location: strong_pi_m.py in this new unit; preserve old code/results
adapter.implementation: Small explicit configurable Coupled adapter initializing CompactTransport with target physical pm, pr=0, sigma=0, mass_fraction=.3, mass_over_Tref=3 and selected quadrature; reuse existing Coupled RHS/Jacobian/diagnostics and AtomicQuotient unchanged. Use distinct case IDs and include physical/model parameters in receipts.
adapter.point_parity: Before new IVPs, verify adapter default cold parameters reproduce old Coupled geometry/RHS at initial state and two finite physical sample states without integration; relative/absolute scaled discrepancy<=1e-11.

acceptance.minimum_continuous_W: min(1+A,1-A/2)>=0; actual targets remain strictly positive
acceptance.full_history: Apply inherited finite, endpoint, isotope sum, number drift and angular brightness gates unchanged; positivity is not checked by arbitrary amplitude alone.
acceptance.control_failure_action: Preserve raw result, report observed failure and scope; no automatic sixth run. Small unresolved effect is a valid scientific outcome, not a computational failure.

observables.primary: max over common-z grid of abs(f_case-f_hot_zero) for each9 conditional channel and allchannels; report maxima and redshifts, endpoint shifts, electron per baryon shift, tau difference
observables.nuclear: all8total nuclei plus21charge entries using earlier plot semantics; T charge unresolved
observables.comparison: All strong-family deltas use new hot zero anchor. Cold-versus-hot zero difference is separately labelled composition/pressure change, not Pi_m effect.

resolution_rule.control_metric: e_f=max_z,q abs(f_Pi.1_L16-f_Pi.1_L24_control); preserve per-channel errors too. This is observed sensitivity to combined discretization/tolerance changes, not a rigorous error bound.
resolution_rule.reference_scale: e_ref=max(e_f,3.3929270504273745e-9) where latter is observed inherited control discrepancy; state its different-family provenance.
resolution_rule.classification: For each strong case report raw amplitude/e_ref. If amplitude>=10*e_ref, describe a response separated from the observed control discrepancy in this conditional family; if amplitude<e_ref, unresolved at observed accuracy; otherwise numerically marginal. No statistical confidence or universal theorem.
resolution_rule.strongest_control_effect: Also compute f_Pi.1_control-f_hot_zero and check the leading effect sign/profile agrees at the peak within the observed discrepancy.
resolution_rule.if_all_unresolved: Document that tested strong Pi up to.1 remains unresolved within this specified family and accuracy; do not generalize to all matter models.

figures.reuse_plot_semantics: PHYSICS_PLOT_CONTRACT.json; retain all earlier28figures and cold-family labels
figures.required_dossier_update: Replace universal interpretation of unresolved Pi_m by a cold-family finding plus the new tested strong-family result and its physical limits.

stopping_rule: Five IVPs maximum, four nominal-case-only nuclear postprocesses, seven figure pairs and one independent scientific review with at most a targeted non-IVP repair. Additional runs require a new explicit decision, not silent scope expansion.
